pr_body:
The trace code assumes all categories are present and
the category numbers are equal to the index in the table.
    
Fixes #19915

##### Checklist

pr_comments:
> Any reason for the change from TLS to HTTP trace category?

The HTTP category is after the ifdefed out TLS category (in fact it is the last one). So this is needed to trigger the ASAN failure in the test without the fix.

issue_context.title: Trace: Index error in trace_attach_cb and other functions
comments:
Instead of this we should just never #ifdef out the trace category entries in the table.
My proposed fix is in https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/19917

IMO there is no point in making the trace categories disappear with no-engines.

review_comments: Shifting the indexes to the end would of probably also worked :)
You mean the engine ones? But we cannot do that as this is a public define.
